title: Admin password reset needs no authentication
description:
The reset route is registered outside the security filter chain.
Any caller can set a new admin password. Café-Nutzer sind betroffen: Zugriff über 管理 Konsole.
intended_behavior: Only an authenticated admin may reset a password

instructions: POST the payload to /admin/reset on a local test instance

remediation.strategy: Remove permitAll for the route and require the ADMIN role

confidence.reason: Reproduced in a sandboxed local instance

title: =HYPERLINK("http://example.invalid","click") export may skip the owner check
description: The export endpoint takes an order id from the query string; whether a gateway enforces ownership is not visible in source.
claimed_root_cause: OrderExportController.export() loads the order by id without comparing the owner

evidence.description: id comes straight from the request

blockers: Gateway ownership policy is not in the repository
No sandbox to run the controller

validation_plan.local: Call the controller with a second dummy tenant's order id in a unit test
validation_plan.deployment: Ask the platform owner whether the gateway filters by owner

title: SQL injection in user search
description: The search term is concatenated into a SQL string, so a caller can change the query: it reads rows, e.g. "x' OR '1'='1", from any table.
root_cause: UserDao.search builds SQL with string concatenation
intended_behavior: The search term is bound as a parameter

evidence.description: "select * from users where name like '%" + q + "%'"

execution.attacker_perspective: An authenticated user of the search page
instructions: Call GET /users/search with the payload as q

remediation.strategy: Use a PreparedStatement with a bound parameter in UserDao.search

likelihood.reason: Any signed-in user can reach it

confidence.reason: Direct source trace with no sanitizer

title: Stored XSS in profile name
description: The name is rendered by a template that escapes output.
reason: The template engine escapes by default and the value is never marked safe
